description: Elections Commission - Declared that Mr. M. G. Weerasena has been elected as a member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 17 Anuradhapura
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member and the declaration of a new elected member. It involves electoral processes, including notification of vacancy, direction to fill the vacancy, and declaration of election results - all falling under election-related matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with portfolio details, or any of the other specialized categories.
